items.label: SpaceX
items.headline: Louisiana built stages of the Saturn V rockets that carried astronauts to the Moon, but has never hosted an orbital launch. SpaceX now plans a $100 billion Gulf Coast spaceport targeting its first Starship flight in 2029 — with an eventual capacity of thousands a year.
items.summary:
SpaceX and Louisiana have announced a 125,000-acre Starship campus targeting a first flight in 2029, but its $100 billion full-buildout plan and thousands-per-year capacity still depend on vehicle reuse, infrastructure, licensing and coastal review.
